description: This PHP script generates various types of documentation test reports based on test plan data within the TestLink open source testing framework. It includes logic for handling different report types such as requirement specifications, test specifications, and execution plans, and produces formatted output for different formats.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: Class responsible for managing requirement specifications, including fetching data from the database.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class representing a test plan, with methods for retrieving test plan details and associated data.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing a test project, with methods to retrieve project details and manage its test structures.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test cases, including their retrieval and hierarchical management within test structures.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Class representing a test suite, providing methods to retrieve and manage test suite data and subtrees.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: Class encapsulating options for document printing such as toggling metrics, table styles, and format settings.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User management class providing methods for user data retrieval and permission checks.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates request parameters, sets up environment context for report generation.

methods.name: initPrintOpt
methods.description: Initializes printing options based on user input or default configuration.

methods.name: getDecode
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares decoding mappings for node types and status codes.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Sets up the environment context including filters, options, and metadata for report generation.

methods.name: getStatsEstimatedExecTime
methods.description: Calculates estimated execution time statistics for test plan items.

methods.name: getStatsRealExecTime
methods.description: Calculates real execution time based on execution data collected.

methods.name: buildContentForTestPlan
methods.description: Builds the content structure for a test plan, considering platforms, branches, and linked test cases.

methods.name: buildContentForTestPlanBranch
methods.description: Builds content for a specific branch within a test plan.

methods.name: timeStatistics
methods.description: Aggregates estimated and real execution time statistics for reporting.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing test plan metrics.
